---
name: New failure mode
about: Propose a failure mode for the catalog
title: "[PREFIX-NN] Short name"
labels: new-entry
---

**Symptom** — What you observe. Concrete and specific.

**Cause** — The mechanism. Why this happens, not what happens.

**Reproduce** — How to trigger it deliberately. Be specific about setup, and say whether it is deterministic or what rate you saw.

**Mitigate** — What actually fixes or contains it. Structural fixes preferred over prompt changes.

---

**Which section does this belong in?**
CTX / TOOL / RAG / COST / EVAL / OPS — or propose a new prefix.

**Have you reproduced this yourself?**
Yes / No. If no, that is fine — say what you observed and someone may be able to reproduce it.

**Anything you are unsure about?**
Uncertainty stated plainly is more useful than confidence you do not have.
